parsed.reason: Strong, playbook-grounded plan: names the 3-Day Method with a one-line why, gates on readiness (2-hour dry, body awareness, no constipation), and prep specifics (potty where you live, salty snacks). Day 1-3 stages use the playbook's own scripts, prompts and outing lengths. It keeps pull-ups for nap/night, applies the no-scolding accident script, and covers weeks 2-4 commando. It sets expectations (not 'done', accidents for weeks, poop lags) and gives the bail-out rule (retry in 4-6 weeks) and the 3+ days no-poop doctor trigger. It recommends one method and names the alternative in a clause. Weaknesses: the 'I'll check in Thursday' day is unexplained and may not fall after day 3 depending on the day; it doesn't clearly say how to tell it's working beyond 'peeing with prompting'; it omits mention of the point where it looks like failing in the middle, and that nights are a later skill is only implied. The 'at 30 months a focused start suits a ready child' is fine. Slightly compressed and dense, but nothing fabricated.
